project_info.theme: Sophisticated black lace red-carpet gala portrait
project_info.color_palette: classic black, deep blue, creamy white, strawberry blonde, soft pink, and silver
project_info.creative_direction: high-fashion event portrait with warm, engaging elegance

main_subject.detail: adult woman with reddish-blonde or strawberry-blonde hair in a textured high bun with loose curly flyaway strands, fair complexion with light freckles and natural rosy cheeks, warm engaging gaze and soft pleasant smile
main_subject.wardrobe: elegant floor-length black gown with a structured matte-black bodice and deep V neckline, layered with an intricate black floral lace shrug or capelet with scalloped edges and fine mesh detailing
main_subject.accessories: large white pearl studs with dangling diamond-encrusted silver drops and a bold statement silver or platinum ring with a diamond cluster

composition_elements.framing: medium close-up and three-quarter waist-up red-carpet portrait variations
composition_elements.subject_position: adult woman centered with hands naturally joined near the waist
composition_elements.background: softly blurred gala event with white floral arrangements, blue-toned backdrop, guests, and event lighting

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: large softbox key with controlled event fill, approximately 4500K to 5200K
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: bright cinematic highlights on hair, lace, pearls, and satin, gentle facial shadows, natural skin texture, and refined red-carpet bokeh

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame portrait camera with 85mm lens at approximately f/2, polished event photography
technical_specs.finish: soft neutral color grade, restrained saturation, visible pores, fine film grain, subtle natural vignetting

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A sophisticated clearly adult woman on a red-carpet gala, with reddish-blonde or strawberry-blonde hair styled in a messy textured high bun with loose curly flyaway strands, fair skin with visible light freckles and a natural rosy flush, a soft pleasant smile showing teeth, warm engaging gaze, minimalist dewy makeup, soft pink lip gloss, and subtle mascara. She wears an elegant floor-length black gown with a structured matte-black bodice and deep V neckline, an intricate black floral lace shrug or capelet draped over the shoulders and chest with scalloped edges and fine mesh detailing, large white pearl studs with dangling diamond-encrusted silver drops, and a bold statement silver or platinum ring with a diamond cluster. Use a softly blurred gala background with hints of white floral arrangements and a blue-toned backdrop with event lighting. Bright cinematic event lighting creates soft highlights on skin, hair, lace, and jewelry. Capture medium close-up and three-quarter waist-up variations with a full-frame camera and 85mm lens at approximately f/2, refined red-carpet bokeh, realistic skin texture, restrained color, and fine film grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, distorted anatomy, malformed jewelry, text artifacts
